## MOQ & lead time
- MOQ: 1 unit for standard SKUs; volume pricing typically from 5 units
- Lead time: 3–5 business days in-stock; custom racks 2–4 weeks after quote

## Payment
- USDT TRC20 online checkout (30-minute window)
- T/T, Wise, PayPal via sales invoice

## Order & delivery flow
1. Browse /products or submit RFQ at /contact
2. Cart checkout (standard SKUs) or sales invoice (bulk / custom)
3. Burn-in QC and export packing in Guangzhou
4. Express (DHL/FedEx/UPS) or sea freight
5. Optional remote ADB setup service post-delivery

## Product lines
Phone farm box · phone farm equipment · Android device farm hardware · mobile device farm · motherboard cluster · real device phone farm · rackmount / 2U phone farm rack · Samsung Snapdragon/Exynos SKUs · lab accessories · custom rack cabinet

## Typical suitable use cases
- Mobile QA and app compatibility on real Android devices
- ADB automation and batch device labs
- Creator studio parallel device workflows
- Digital marketing / mobile ad QA on real hardware
- E-commerce app regression testing
- Labs upgrading from desk chargers to factory chassis

## Not suitable / out of scope
- Cloud phone or virtual device SaaS replacement
- Proprietary software lock-in bundles
- iOS-only multi-node farms (Android-first catalog)
- Turnkey social platform policy automation
- Same-day local pickup outside export workflow
